changelog: App device live speeds and Wi-Fi metadata are synchronized with the same rich LanGuard Pro snapshot as LuCI.
Device rename/IP changes invalidate caches and are confirmed after refresh.
Offline LAN/Wi-Fi remembered devices can be removed with a left-swipe Delete action.
Router speed test now uses sustained-transfer timing to reduce TLS/setup under-reporting.
SQM/CAKE setup verifies an active CAKE qdisc and reconnects the app session without reboot.
Unified update notices cover the Android app, Router Companion, and LuCI LanGuard Pro.
Per-device speed limits now use verified nftables prerouting/download and postrouting/upload enforcement.
High/Low priority uses verified IPv4 DSCP rules instead of silently ignored MAC rules.
Speed and priority policy failures roll back saved state instead of reporting false success.
Speed test fallback uses adaptive sustained transfers and excludes connection/TLS setup time.
Online devices are protected from remembered-device deletion.
Speed Control uses the shared verified R8 limiter backend.
Device policy editor supports Normal, High and Low traffic priority.
Saved speed and priority policy state refreshes immediately in LuCI and Android.
